title: Now tree expands the full descendant hierarchy
description:
Now tree view must let operators expand and collapse nodes that have descendants, including children that do not match the current Status filter.

Default Status is in_progress. An in-progress epic must still show an expand control when it has open, blocked, or closed children. Expanding drills into the full descendant tree; collapsing hides those children again.

Flat feed (Tree off) stays status-filtered. Generation still does not backfill closed descendants; this is display only.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  filter["Status filter"] --> roots["matching issues as roots"]
  roots --> expand["expand control if descendants exist"]
  expand --> children["all descendants any status"]
```

comments.author: home
comments.text: Now tree includes descendants outside the Status filter. Matching issues stay collapsed by default and show an expand control when they have children. Expanding drills one level at a time through the full descendant tree. Type filter is hidden on Now.
